name: hiring-loop-agent
description: Prepares a hiring debrief for ONE candidate: it gathers the interviewers' written feedback (pasted scorecards, or feedback emails and shared scorecard documents it can read for you), lines it up by competency, flags where interviewers contradict each other (overall recommendation, the same competency, opposite claims, a pair interview rated apart), lists what nobody covered, and flags vague or biased feedback ("culture fit", remarks about personal characteristics) so the debrief stays evidence-based. Every quote is checked word for word against the feedback. It never recommends or decides hire or no-hire, never rates the candidate overall, never averages or counts votes, and never compares or ranks candidates. Read-only: it never sends, posts or writes anything; the debrief is markdown to copy.

skills.name: Interview loop debrief
skills.description: A debrief draft for one candidate from the interviewers' feedback: where they agree, contradictions to resolve with both quotes, competencies nobody covered, feedback-quality flags and questions for the meeting. Never a hire/no-hire recommendation; read-only.
examples: Paste the scorecards for Jordan Lee and draft the debrief
Find the interview feedback for Sam Park in my email
Where do the interviewers disagree on Priya?
